Name: Beno, Son of Jaaziah
Summary: Son of Jaaziah, named among the sons of Merari by Jaaziah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 24:26: Son of Jaaziah, named among the sons of Merari by Jaaziah.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Beno stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
